تزجوا (form I)
# تَزُجُّوا (tazujjū) /ta.zud͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of زَجَّ (zajja)
# تُزَجُّوا (tuzajjū) /tu.zad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of زَجَّ (zajja)
